description.subtitle: Short sleeve cotton shirt adidas from the Italian selection - white
description.tagline: Herencia italiana reinterpretada en clave Originals
description.intro: The adidas Originals Italia T-shirt is a tribute to the classic style and football heritage of the Italian combination. It fuses contemporary sports and aesthetic tradition into a modern silhouette to take its passion beyond the playing field.
key_benefits: Inspiration in the second equipment: Design that evokes the historical identity of Italy.
Soft knit fabric: Lightness, comfort and pleasant touch throughout the day.
Slim fit: Stylized fit with current air.
Classic round neck: Timeless finish easy to combine.
Trefoil logo and official coat of arms: Authenticity adidas with a football character.

key_benefits: Inspiración en la segunda equipación: Diseño que evoca la identidad histórica de Italia.
Tejido de punto suave: Ligereza, confort y tacto agradable durante todo el día.
Corte slim fit: Ajuste estilizado con aire actual.
Cuello redondo clásico: Acabado atemporal fácil de combinar.
